answer: Re-attestations are stored in onyx and vault lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the meadow graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1830 impostors cost 1979 times the honest price and take 28 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
